scores.rationale: The pinned v4 contract, baseline commit, A-N donor decisions, and selective-integration boundary are coherent. The contract and candidate fingerprints reproduced exactly from both the working tree and candidate commit; the lineage baseline is an ancestor, the candidate is HEAD, no merge commits occur in the lineage, and all implementation changes are fingerprint-bound apart from the four explicitly permitted evaluator-owned evidence paths.

Fresh lifecycle, citation, Wiki graph, NYCAC census, route, and public-safety checks passed. Mutation suites exercised unknown and orphaned references, duplicate IDs, unsupported evidence relationships, intake disposition loss, citation drift, non-recovery misuse, projection errors, and editorial/source-return graph damage without modifying the frozen 27-eval suite.

Independent exact-set validation found every public proof classified by one agency relation with canonical support closure, bounded action, usable result, credit scope, confidence, and anti-claims. Candidate mutation checks cover missing classifications, sole causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, unknown support, public-route wording drift, and endorsement drift; semantic inspection found Jamie visible without converting collective work into individual ownership.

All three operator help surfaces were usable. A public-safe intake candidate validated without creating a canonical record or projection; held, research, and proof-debt queries returned bounded public-safe fields; invalid views returned nonzero. Operator, graph, private-marker, credential, and compiled-output leak controls are explicit and mutation-sensitive.

The survivorship exact set includes recovered, partial, not-recovered, and indirect populations with bounded negative language and graph-linked inquiries. Factual support, quotation permission, artifact rights, image permission, participant consent, and display approval remain separate; protected custody stays outside Git and all discovery paths re-enter through intake or inquiry without automatic maturation.

Independent validation found exact composition coverage, selector binding, per-route and per-case-study budgets, canonical projection closure, and complete selected-versus-held proof accounting. The candidate-bound mosaic review contains nine combination-risk findings, continuing holds, and explicit non-approval limitations; the public site remains a selective portfolio rather than a bank or search surface.

This judge independently reproduced the frozen contract and exact candidate fingerprints, authored no patch, remained behaviorally read-only, and did not inspect optimization history, composite state, integration run, or either holdout receipt. Receipt-level trust is strong, but one receipt cannot establish aggregate two-receipt completion, so the score is capped at 3 as required.

Fresh Node 26 typecheck, lint, optimized Next.js production build, compiled leak scan, staging runtime smoke, health response, primary-route rendering, robots output, and noindex response-header checks passed. The 27-eval suite and Wiki/hiring suites also passed. Source policy keeps staging noindex and makes production indexing an explicit environment choice behind exact-candidate human approval; hands-on accessibility and launch QA correctly remain human-pending, so this receipt does not claim production readiness.

PR-019 target-reader response and PR-025 hands-on launch QA remain pending with no reviewer, review date, or candidate approval. Jamie authorship, artifact rights, collaborator and participant consent, application sharing, production approval, and indexing are separately named gates; no automated score or AI judgment resolves them.
